ec-c-vip-customers-split.question: How many of our customers are VIP, how many are not, and for how many do we not know?

ec-c-vip-customers-split.notes: Verified 2026-11-18: 15000 / 30000 / 5000. Trap: WHERE is_vip = false misses 5000 unknowns, or NOT is_vip lumps them: 35000. Result (2026-11-18): 15000|30000|5000. Fixed 2026-11-18: reference is the three counts, one per row, with distinctRows, so a long-form answer (one row per group, extra total column) and a wide one-row answer both pass; the lumped-NULL trap still lacks one count.

expectedSql.postgres: SELECT v.n AS customers FROM (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vip IS TRUE) AS t, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vip IS FALSE) AS f, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vip IS NULL) AS u FROM edge_cases.customers) s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (s.t), (s.f), (s.u)) AS v(n)
